;"Repository-local Troll Disarm & Stolen Weapons. Release 1254 retains the
  qualified Release 1253 dam-survival world while letting the canonical troll
  seize real weapons lost in combat, keep and use that exact custody, taunt the
  player with it, trade it back for food, and surrender it through real combat
  outcomes. Canonical combat, troll strength, axe behavior, and exits remain authority."
replacements.new:
"ZORK1 GRUE ECOLOGY AND COLONY REVEAL GLULX for
  Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
  (c) Copyright 1983 Infocom, Inc. All Rights Reserved."

;"Repository-local Grue Ecology & Colony Reveal. Release 1256 keeps canonical
  darkness and grue lethality authoritative while turning one optional mine dead
  end into an authored ecology experiment: weak light gives plural evidence, the
  permanent ivory torch forces a signature colony retreat, and no grue becomes an
  ordinary visible combat monster."
